description: This file defines the EqualBinary class within Twig, which extends an abstract binary expression class to implement equality comparison logic in Twig templates.

classes.name: EqualBinary
classes.description: Represents the equality ('==') binary operation in Twig expressions, compiling the comparison accordingly for different PHP versions.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the equal binary expression into PHP code, using a specific comparison method for PHP versions below 8.0.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string '==' representing the equality operator.
